meta.title: UN field missions represented in the Cultural Intelligence & Bias Navigator
meta.compilationNote: unmissions.org could not be loaded directly when this dataset was compiled, because the build environment's network policy blocked it. Entries were compiled from search-indexed copies of the UN field-missions directory, mission sites on unmissions.org subdomains, the DPO 'Where we operate' page and Security Council documents. Every entry has a verification field. Check each one against the live directory before a public demonstration and update this file; the app picks up changes automatically.

verificationLegend.confirmed: Name, scope and status confirmed against a UN source surfaced during compilation.
verificationLegend.check-status: The mission exists, but its mandate is ending, under renewal or changing close to the compilation date. Check its current status.
verificationLegend.check-listing: A UN presence that DPPA supports. Confirm that it appears on the unmissions.org directory and that the source URL resolves.

meta.coordinatesNote: Map markers show mission headquarters or main offices, not the full area of operations. Where a mandate covers several countries, all of them are listed under geographic scope.

missions.name: United Nations Verification Mission in Colombia

missions.name: United Nations Office to the African Union
missions.scopeNote: Strengthens the UN–African Union partnership on peace and security. It is a liaison office, not a country mission.
